contract:password-hashers.evidence: Scope: hasher library only (encode/verify/must_update/make_password/is_password_usable), not the password stage or login flow. `tests/differential/passwords/run.sh` on 2026-10-30: 152/152 encodings byte-identical to Django 5.2.17, 65/65 verify_password outcomes (incl. raised exceptions) equal, 31/31 Rust-made hashes accepted by Django check_password, reference akadmin row verifies.

web:frontend.rust: unchanged; served by the Rust server from web/dist
